text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Good news, everyone! For Blast's 
birthday project... a special collab 
stream has been officially confirmed!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's really happening!? A collab 
stream with Loves...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The announcement for our collab got a huge 
reaction♡ I'm sure so, so many 
listeners—thousands of them—will tune in~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm definitely passing the message 
along, okay? That there are tons of 
comments too♪

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, ehehe... So many people are gonna 
come hang out with Buu...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Still, performing in front of thousands of 
people is a first for me. H-Hey, what am I 
supposed to do? How do I make everyone 
happy~?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Don't overthink it, just be your usual 
self. I'm sure they want to see the real 
you, Blast-san!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hmm! But if I do that, I'm just gonna end 
up repeating 'I love you!' and 'Thank 
you!' thousands of times over and over, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, it's super lovely! 
Either way, just do what you always do! 
Let's spread the love♡

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Really? If that's the case... hehe. I'm 
gonna shower them with sooo much love!
